raw_response:
This plot is small, and here in Kigoma I do not usually spend much money on chemical inputs for this kind of mixed crop field. I will rely mostly on local seed, family work, and some manure if I can get it, because that is cheaper and more manageable for me. I do not expect to irrigate, and I am not planning to use pesticide unless there is a serious problem.
